evidence: Mechanism (code-verified): scoring.toml (template-identical) has gates render/constraints = 0.0 and [floors] functional = 0.05; score.py:41 gates_passed = all(score > 0.0), :47-48 reward = weighted only if gates_passed and functional > 0.05, else 0.0; test.sh:213-222 skips the scored suite when gates fail (score.py exit 1), and test.sh:60 writes a zero reward first so every early exit (no server.js, foreign symlink, not ready in 30 s) is 0. I replayed score.py with synthetic suite outputs (scratch copy, python -B): constraints=0 with polish/visual=1 -> 0.0; render=0 -> 0.0; gates pass but functional=0 or one 1.5-weight criterion (1.5/44=0.034) with polish=visual=1 -> 0.0 (floors_passed 0); two 1.5 criteria (3/44) -> 0.3609. Functional weights sum to 44 (16 criteria), so beating the floor needs at least 2.2 weight, i.e. two independently passing real-behaviour criteria. Per case: blank page / generic error -> render gate (render/judge.toml authenticated_render requires a real Kittle & Rowe matter chat, wrong password rejected, Gwen's matters and messages) fails -> 0. Static mock / seed copy / localStorage facade -> constraints/judge.toml server_backed_local_application requires posting 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' in M-11, reload, and Harriet in a separate browser context seeing it; a static or client-only copy cannot pass -> 0. Keyword-stuffed page: the gate probe is created at grading time and must round-trip through the server across contexts, and every scored criterion's negatives carry paired positive controls (functional prompt.md:51-52 'Every refusal pairs with a success of the same kind'; e.g. wall_every_route, hold_scope_and_release, timer_changes all start with working posts/searches/deletes), so stuffed 'not available'/seed strings earn nothing. Refusing submission: refusing sign-in fails render; refusing the post fails constraints ('A message that never saves ... fails this gate'); constraints prompt.md:61-63 states a blank page, broken sign-in or unavailable operation is not proof of a constraint. All three scored prompts restate the global gate (functional prompt.md:11-19, polish :10-18, visual :18-26) naming blank page, empty workspace, static mock, static shell, missing backend and seeded-looking facade, zeroing the dimension; polish/visual cannot be farmed because the functional floor zeros the whole reward. Off-origin/CDN fetches are explicitly allowed in every gate (render prompt.md:12-13, constraints :64-65, judge.toml description), consistent with the public network note. Plausible broken app that could pass: none of the five floor archetypes survives the mechanism; the nearest is a real server-backed chat that implements only replies and formatting (two 1.5 criteria) and earns ~0.36 with good polish/visual - that is a working partial app, not a shell, and its weighting belongs to rows 42/44 (noted, not a #39 defect). Conforming alternative that could fail: the gates allow any route, cookie, or CDN asset and do not prescribe structure, so a conforming app is not floored. Risk=true only because the judge-level discrimination is unmeasured: raw-evidence-index.json scope says a full configured grading run and reward discrimination/ranking on these bytes are absent, and the scripted golden run did not cover render or shell/mock variants; the claim that the LLM judge actually rejects a convincing facade at the gates is reasoned, not observed.
